title.narrative: Strengthening sub-national dialogue on Urban and Territorial Sustainable Development in Mozambique: Phase 3

description.narrative:
The objective of the proposed project is to foster the strategic vision of the sub-national government towards sustainable integrated and equitable territorial development and urbanization. The resultant Outcome is a strengthened technical and institutional capacity of government at sub-national level towards strategic gender sensitive territorial planning and national and sub-national urbanization policies.
This project will constitute the Phase 3 of an overall continuous intervention implemented by UN-Habitat under the funding of the Catalan Agency for Cooperation and Development (ACCD), in coordination with the Ministry of Land and Environment (MTA), the Ministry of State Administration and Public Function (MAEFP) and the Executive Council of Inhambane Province (CEPI). In the previous two phases, the Spatial Structure of Inhambane province had been studied by UN-Habitat through the Matrix of Functions tool, in order to support the planning strategical capacities at the provincial level. The identification of priority development areas of the Province and settlement clusters, priority development nodes providing important functions for rural communities, and priority development corridors, promoting connectivity throughout the Province helped understanding and spatializing the development possibilities of the provincial territory in a simple, readable way for decision-makers and urban planners. Also, the results of the MoF and SDF were used to inform provincial strategic plans in Inhambane (Provincial Strategic Plan – PEPI, Provincial Territorial Development Plan – PPDT), as well as the National Urbanization Policy (NUP) in its sub-national component.
The present project stands as a subsequent phase of the mentioned project, to capitalize and strengthen the provincial planning adquired capacities towards a broader urban planning and policy support at the provincial and national level. This project will capitalize the results of the first and second phases with the aims of (i) endorsing, disseminating and systematize the PPDT at the national, provincial and local scale, including mainstreaming of the lessons learnt regarding the inclusion of gender-based vision and issues in the planning exercise at the sub-national level, and (ii) supporting the dissemination implementation of the national urbanization policy at the provincial level.
This capitalization will in fact occur during the crucial moment of transition between the validation phase and the dissemination (together with the institutional preparation for implementation) phase of the National Urbanization Policy, in which strategical, logistic and institutional support is strongly needed in terms of familiarization with the policy and its mainstreaming. In this phase, and also through the support of this project, MTA will collaborate hand by hand with MAEFP for the main event of dissemination of the policy at the provincial level. Parallely, Inhambane province will be capacitated in terms of endorsing of national policies. This kind of institutional scale-down and endorsement is seen as fundamental step to be achieved in all the provinces for a proper implementation of the policy. Inhambane province will play a lead role for this, being able to contextualise and communicate the national policy at the sub-national scale.
